From day one, I’ve been committed to protecting our nation’s most vulnerable — our children.

Proud to join bipartisan legislation to clarify federal law and close a loophole that could allow child predators to evade prosecution. britt.senate.gov/news/press-…

Had a great meeting with my friend Kevin Warsh last month — President Trump’s nominee to lead the Federal Reserve. I look forward to supporting his confirmation and working with him to deliver a strong, stable economy that hardworking Americans deserve.

The Working Families Tax Cuts Act puts real money back in the pockets of hardworking Americans this tax season. 

The average individual filer is receiving a federal tax refund of $3,462. No tax on tips, no tax on overtime, and relief for seniors—more money back in your pocket where it belongs.

Promises made, promises kept.


Working Families Tax Cuts (@TaxCuts)
